basic_details.job_title: NIT Warangal Junior Research Fellow (ECE) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Technology Warangal has advertised one Junior Research Fellow post for a three-year project, "3D Object Detection Using Graph Convolutional Neural network", sponsored by the Army Technology Board (ATB). The pay is Rs. 37,000 per month for the first two years and Rs. 42,000 per month for the third year, with HRA as per institute rules. M.E./M.Tech. in a listed discipline is the essential qualification. Applications go by email to [email protected], with the last date 30/11/2026 at 11.59pm.

how_to_apply: Take the application proforma attached with the advertisement ("Application for the Position of Junior Research Fellow", Position under ATB Sponsored Research Project).

Complete it with name, father's name, date of birth, sex, marital status, category (OC/OBC/SC/ST), educational qualifications, GATE/NET/ICMR/DBT-SRF score, experience, publications and any other relevant information.
Sign the declaration at the end of the form. It includes a confirmation of availability for an online interview, if necessary.
Enclose a brief resume / curriculum vitae / bio-data with the application form.
Send the soft copy by email to [email protected] by 30/11/2026 @11.59pm.

The notice does not state a subject line for the email. For queries, the contact is Prof. T. Kishore Kumar, Dept. of ECE, National Institute of Technology Warangal – 506 004, Telangana State, India; phone +91 8332969353; email [email protected].
important_instructions: The position is purely temporary. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Under the declaration, if information is found false or incorrect, or any ineligibility is detected before or after selection, the candidature is liable to be cancelled.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification is M.E./M.Tech. in Computer Science / Electronics and Communication Engineering / Artificial Intelligence / Embedded Systems or related disciplines from a recognized Institute/University with a good academic record. The age limit is 30 years; the notice prints no "as on" date and no age relaxation. Desired qualifications: GATE/NET Knowledge of programming using Python/MATLAB and fundamentals of Machine Learning/Deep Learning For discipline-specific eligibility, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The project duration is 3 years, and the notice states that the position is purely temporary. HRA is paid as per institute rules. The selected candidate is also eligible for on-campus hostel and mess facilities, subject to availability.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The list of eligible candidates will be announced on the institute website and also intimated through email or phone. Shortlisted candidates will have to attend an interview (online or offline). If the interview is online, candidates are expected to have a good internet connection. The notice does not give an interview date.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The position is purely temporary. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Under the declaration, if information is found false or incorrect, or any ineligibility is detected before or after selection, the candidature is liable to be cancelled.

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Research Fellow posts has NIT Warangal advertised?
faq.answer: The notice advertises one Junior Research Fellow position under the ATB-sponsored project "3D Object Detection Using Graph Convolutional Neural network".

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Warangal JRF post?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 30/11/2026 @11.59pm.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the NIT Warangal JRF post?
faq.answer: M.E./M.Tech. in Computer Science / Electronics and Communication Engineering / Artificial Intelligence / Embedded Systems or related disciplines from a recognized Institute/University with a good academic record. GATE/NET is desired.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit printed in the notice is 30 years. The notice prints no cut-off date and no relaxation.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the NIT Warangal JRF?
faq.answer: Rs. 37,000/- per month for the first two years and Rs. 42,000/- per month for the third year, with HRA as per institute rules.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Complete the attached application proforma, enclose a brief resume/CV/bio-data and email the soft copy to [email protected] before the last date.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates are listed on the institute website and intimated by email or phone. Shortlisted candidates then attend an interview, online or offline.

faq.question: Q8. Is the NIT Warangal JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notice states the position is purely temporary, for a project duration of 3 years.

faq.question: Q9. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can the selected JRF register for a PhD at NIT Warangal?
faq.answer: Yes, as per institute rules. The candidate still needs to apply for a PhD position when that advertisement is open.
